Lithuania calls off air alert warning in Vilnius and Utena regions

Lithuania’s authorities issued an air alert warning (code yellow), on Tuesday evening at around 23:00, urging people to locate their nearest shelter and wait for updates. The warning was issued in the counties of Vilnius and Utena. It was called off before midnight.

“The Lithuanian Armed Forces inform: POSSIBLE AIR RAID ALERT (YELLOW). Find a safe place. If you see a suspicious object, keep away, call 112. Wait for the all-clear,” the authorities said in an emergency message.

An object was detected in Belarus travelling toward Lithuania, the authorities said, adding that it was still unclear whether it was a drone.

Code yellow does not mean there is an imminent danger, but people should be prepared to seek shelter in case the authorities declare an air alert warning (code red).
